response.justification: Bogdan demonstrates extensive experience in software engineering with a strong focus on full-stack development, AI-agent infrastructure, and open-source contributions. However, his background lacks direct experience in AI strategy, cloud product development, or entrepreneurial roles within larger organizations. While his technical skills are solid, his experience does not fully align with the director-level AI strategy focus required for this role.
strengths: Strong full-stack engineering experience with diverse technologies (TypeScript, DLang, Node.js, React, etc.)
Experience with AI-agent infrastructure and developer tooling, including MCP and agentic workflows
Proven ability to lead open-source projects (GISCollective) and deliver high-performance systems
concerns: Limited direct experience in AI strategy or cloud product development at a director level
No clear evidence of entrepreneurial or startup experience within larger organizations
Lacks a Master's or PhD in an AI-related field or recognized expertise in AI with built products

key_factors.factor: AI strategy and cloud product experience
